title: Current-v6 soup mixed-opponent contract smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Starting from the strongest current-v6 external-tested procedural actor soup, a reset-optimizer all-policy-head continuation can execute an auditable 50/50 procedural and adaptive diverse learned-opponent mixture while preserving fresh hand accounting, finite PPO/source-KL metrics, and identity-safe assignment provenance.
material_change: Use the frozen current-v6 soup as both initialization and KL reference, reset its interpolation-incompatible optimizer and hand counter, and expose sampled PPO to 50% procedural styles plus an adaptive four-checkpoint current-v6 learned population.
baseline: The same frozen soup scored -41.8162 bb/100 over audited current-v6 greedy fresh20k. Prior learned leagues started from Standard10 and prior procedural training used an all-procedural treatment; neither tested this initialization-distribution combination.

notes: Preregistered technical gate only: terminal actual physical hands >=8192, iteration starts fresh, optimizer advances from a fresh state rather than the soup's stale interpolated moments, assignment chain/session audit pass, all configured learned identities and procedural hands are observed, finite metrics, zero KL early stops. No strength promotion from smoke reward.
Prerun contract/accounting regression suite PASS: 28 tests.
Trainer rejected argv before environment initialization: procedural-opponent-fraction is explicitly incompatible with adaptive-opponent-league. No run directory/checkpoint/hands were produced.

result.summary: Prerun tests passed, then the trainer rejected the preregistered adaptive-plus-procedural mixture before environment initialization; zero training/evaluation/Slumbot hands.
result.conclusion: The current trainer contract cannot jointly schedule procedural hands and adaptive learned-opponent weights. This is a clean design incompatibility, not evidence about policy strength.
result.next_step: Run a separately logged corrected smoke using uniform learned-opponent membership with the same 50% procedural share; if valid, isolate learned-population diversity by comparing a one-member versus four-member uniform pool.
